design_rationale:
DRAW (draw_counts.py --task 1): 3 prerequisites; factor counts [5,5,4,6]. Tree:
- Root: activity_ext_arts_first_installment (owner=user payment, 4 factors).
- Prerequisites:
  - activity_ext_arts_packet_fee (owner=user packet, 5 factors).
  - activity_ext_arts_travel_fee (agent, 6 factors).
  - activity_ext_arts_attire_fee (agent, 5 factors).
- Edges:
  - travel -> packet, gate at_permission_count.
  - attire -> packet, gate ap_packet_count.
  - installment -> packet / travel / attire, gates fi_part_net, fi_travel_net, fi_attire_net.
- Resolution order: packet, travel, attire, installment (travel and attire commute).
The persona asks only to start the band payment plan and pay the first installment online.
SCOPE (record test): a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03. Participation facb8f40: band, 2026-27, registered 2027-01-11. It is in scope, and no late registration fee is owed.
WORLD:
- Karin Lindgren, Leander (outside the district).
- Elin Lindgren, 440459, grade 06.
- 2026-27 enrollment: Non-Resident Transfer at Hollis Middle School. The request was approved 2026-03-20.
- Paid meal account.
- Instrument checkout: Large Instrument Usage (tuba, HMS-TU-74118), checked out 2027-01-14.
- No ledger or records-log rows at the opening.
FACTOR CARDS:
- Packet 75.00 = RND(MX(0, 75 + 15 + 10) x 150% x 50%):
  - arts_rate_tier: R1, activity x grade, multi-source.
  - arts_level_tier: R1, grade band.
  - arts_campus_tier: R1, campus on the enrollment record.
  - arts_residency_tier: R1, residence.
  - membership_term_rule: method R3.
- Travel 107.00 = RND(MX(0, 160 - 40) x 120% x 50% + 10 + 25):
  - arts_travel_rate_tier: R1.
  - arts_trip_group_tier: R1, multi-source.
  - arts_travel_residency_tier: R1.
  - arts_trip_share_rule: method R3, 2 of the band's 4 trips (one or none -> single-trip pct per trip; two or three -> count of four; otherwise full 100 = baseline).
  - late_booking_tier: R6. The packet's received date against the first trip on or after it.
  - instrument_haul_tier: R6. The music checkout usage_type; this is transport of the instrument, not maintenance.
- Attire 62.00 = RND(MX(0, 40 - 15 + 5) + 12 + 20). The package is student-kept apparel bought whole, so it has no term and no proration:
  - attire_rate_tier: R1, ensemble.
  - attire_level_tier: R1, grade band.
  - attire_campus_tier: R1, campus.
  - order_timing_tier: R2. Registration date against the group order (2026-09-15) and winter order (2026-11-15) dates; individual order +12.
  - rush_order_rule: method R2. Packet received 9 days before the 2027-02-11 concert: 10 + 2 per day short of 14 = 20; flat 8 at 14-27 days; otherwise nothing.
- Installment 225.25 = 107.00 + 37.50 + 62.00 + floor_cent(37.50 / 2):
  - plan_count_tier: R5.
  - travel_placement_rule: method R2, the next scheduled trip.
  - plan_lead_tier: R2, registration-to-payment days.
  - attire_placement_tier: R2, attire posting date against the next concert.
HISTORY: 9 rows. The travel and attire fees read the three packet forms on the records log. The installment nets three fee entries against the credits sourced to each.
SENSITIVITY:
- Packet: 63.75 / 63.75 / 67.50 / 50.00 / 150.00 (baseline 60.00).
- Travel: 98.00 / 131.00 / 95.00 / 179.00 / 97.00 / 82.00 (baseline 145.00).
- Attire: 32.00 / 77.00 / 57.00 / 50.00 / 42.00 (baseline 0.00).
- Installment: 219.00 / 171.75 / 206.50 / 194.25 (baseline 81.33).
EDGE SKIPS:
- Installment: 169.00 without the participation fee; 137.00 without the travel fee (the plan total falls below 150, so there is one installment); 163.25 without the attire.
- Travel and attire: 0.00 without the packet.
PROBES:
- Paid meal status, no application.
- Absent records-log and ledger rows at the opening.
- One checkout (first checked_out rule); a Summer Instrument Checkout is excluded by name.
- A packet received after the last concert or trip gives no rush or booking amount.
- Same-day packet forms share one received date.
- No late fee: in-scope participations post none (S2 overwrite).
- Enrollment selection: every enrollment read takes the student's record in status enrolled for the participation's school year. A withdrawn 2026-27 record, even one stored first, is not read; with no enrolled record, every enrollment-based tier falls to 'otherwise'. No decoy is seeded: a mid-year transfer updates the existing record, and the task-1 student is new to the district. The probe was run in rework round 6.
RUN: check_compute packet 75.00, travel 107.00, attire 62.00, installment 225.25, match True.
user_scenario:
You are Karin Lindgren. Your family lives in Leander, just outside the district, and your daughter Elin Lindgren goes to Hollis Middle School on a non-resident transfer; she's a sixth grader. In January the band director added Elin to the beginning band and checked out a school tuba to her, and she loves it. You're warm, a bit apologetic, and you like to get things settled in one call.

The band director told you Elin can't go on the band's spring trip on February 26th until her band fees are on a payment plan with the first payment made, and that you can pay it online yourself. You are calling to start the payment plan and make the first payment today. You'd like to pay it yourself online by card while you're on the phone. You don't know what the band fees come to or how the district figures them, and you never suggest an amount.

When the agent asks you to confirm your identity, you give your phone number, 5125550172, and the last four digits of your driver's license, 4458. Only if they ask for more do you give your date of birth, May 21, 1986, or your email, karin.lindgren@gmail.com. Elin's student ID number is 440459 if they need it. If the agent asks about school lunches, Elin pays full price; you never applied for meal benefits.

If the agent tells you there is something you have to sign and submit yourself first, you say you thought that was done but you'll do it now; when the agent hands it to you, you submit it exactly with the details the agent gives you. If the agent says fees have to be put on her account before the payment can be worked out, you say that's fine. When the agent hands you the payment, you pay it yourself right away by card, exactly the amount the agent gives you. If the agent reads you any amounts, you accept them without arguing.

Once your payment has gone through and you have the confirmation number, you thank the agent and end the call.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The travel fee and the concert attire package both follow the packet and write different fee components; neither reads the other's entry, so they give 107.00 and 62.00 in either order and the terminal state is the same. The first installment follows all three, as its prerequisite sentences state.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the packet's participation fee the first installment is 169.00 instead of 225.25.
Without the travel fee the plan total falls below 150.00, the plan has one installment and the payment is 137.00 instead of 225.25.
Without the attire package the first installment is 163.25 instead of 225.25.
Without the packet no overnight permission is on file and the travel fee schedule posts nothing (0.00) instead of 107.00.
Without the packet there is no received date and no attire package is ordered (0.00) instead of 62.00.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to start the plan and make the first payment; it never mentions the packet, the travel fee or the concert attire; the related lines are passive reactions once the agent raises them.
